text:
Asha: Hey team :wave: I'm Asha, starting today. Trying to finish laptop setup but MDM enrollment keeps failing on the company MacBook Air M2. It says 'Enrollment failed - device not eligible'. Did People Ops register this serial?
Sam (IT): Welcome! :tada: Can you paste the Mac serial (from About This Mac) or run `system_profiler SPHardwareDataType | grep Serial`? Also which macOS version?
Asha: Serial is C02XYZ12345, macOS 13.6. I'm seeing a prompt 'This Mac is supervised' then error.
Sam (IT): Thanks. Quick checklist: 1) Confirm device is assigned in DEP/ASM; 2) Connect to corp VPN (some DEP checks hit infra); 3) If you used personal Apple ID and enabled Activation Lock, that blocks enrollment.
Asha: I didn't touch Activation Lock as far as I know. How do I check?
Sam (IT): Run `sudo fdesetup status` to see FileVault and `profiles -P` to list profiles. If Activation Lock is on you'll see an ActivationLock/FindMy entry in the iCloud section under System Settings. If there's an Activation Lock we need People Ops to request a release from Apple or provide the device's purchase order.
Asha: `profiles -P` shows an MDM profile but the Jamf agent icon is greyed and `mdm.enrollment.status` shows failed.
Sam (IT): Ok likely partial enrollment. Try the manual re-enroll step: connect to corp VPN, then in Terminal run: 
```
sudo jamf removeMDMProfile -confirm
sudo jamf enroll -prompt
```
That will remove the stale profile and re-trigger DEP flow. If it errors, paste the exact message.
Asha: Ran remove and enroll. Enroll asked for an admin username/password. I don't have admin creds. It failed with 'admin privileges required'.
Sam (IT): We don't give permanent admin. For enrollment we can grant a temporary admin lift via our self-service ticket. I created a short-lived admin token tied to your serial — try again now. If it prompts for auth, use your Redwood email and the one-time code I DMed.
Asha: OK it completed! I see Jamf MDM, profile installed, and FileVault prompting to enable.
Riley (People Ops): Hi Asha, welcome again! I confirmed your device serial is in ASM and assigned to our MDM. If anything else trips during onboarding ping me and I can reassign assets.
Asha: FileVault is asking to enable. Is that required?
Sam (IT): Yes, company policy requires disk encryption. Enable it and make sure the recovery key is escrowed to Jamf during the prompt. If the UI doesn't escrow, run `sudo fdesetup enable -outputplist` and send the recovery plist to IT (we'll upload to KMS).
Asha: Enabled FileVault, jamf shows status 'Encrypted'. Thanks! Quick follow-up — will macOS updates be auto-managed?
Sam (IT): Yep, we push critical updates through Jamf. Minor updates can be deferred for 7 days but security updates are enforced. Patch window is nightly 02:00-05:00 your local time; you may see an automated restart.
Asha: Great. One last thing — do I need sudo for Homebrew?
Sam (IT): Don't install system-level packages with admin unless instructed. Use a user-local Homebrew install under /usr/local or /opt/homebrew (no sudo). For anything you must escalate for, open an IT ticket or ping me.
Asha: Awesome, everything working now. Thanks Sam and Riley :heart:
deploy-bot: Provisioning status: device C02XYZ12345 - enrollment: succeeded, filevault: enabled, MDM: active.
Sam (IT): Marking thread resolved. If you hit any other blockers, reply here or DM.
